description: R08 DeserializationTests global-load seam: portable Rust owns startup dimension clamping, permissive JSON trailing commas, built-in default profile activation, and legacy reload-environment migration into profile defaults.

entries.notes: DeserializedProfiles applies the exact GlobalAppSettings LayerJson clamp range 1..=999 after global layering; the Microsoft 1000000/-1000000 vector resolves to 999/1.
The shared settings_json parser accepts Microsoft's trailing comma after the profiles array and the resulting Cascadia profile aggregate loads normally.
DeserializedProfiles loads the two exact built-in profile identities/names from TerminalSettingsModel/defaults.json and reports active profile count equal to total profile count, both 2.

CascadiaSettingsDocument exposes the existing portable load fixup: legacy root compatibility.reloadEnvironmentVariables is removed, fixup state is true, and profiles.defaults receives the exact false value.
